title.en: JANUS Connection Scan — Minimal Sufficient Information Core and Operator Stability
title.ru: JANUS Connection Scan — минимальное достаточное информационное ядро и устойчивость оператора

scan_scope: selected Tranception, Dougan, SCOBY, Cardputer, child-protection, signal and proof-carrying records

primary_hidden_node_candidate.name: MINIMAL_SUFFICIENT_INFORMATION_CORE
primary_hidden_node_candidate.definition: The smallest set of source-level information elements that must remain present for a candidate connection to be detected while removing non-essential metadata, lineage, narrative framing, authority labels and derivative artifacts.
primary_hidden_node_candidate.core_question: What is the smallest information set that still causes the machine to recover the same relationship?
primary_hidden_node_candidate.why_elevated_order: This moves beneath event-level independence: even one independent event may contain many fields, only some of which carry the relational signal.

connections.machine_observation: Across otherwise different records, the interpretable relation can be reduced to an observation, a constraint/gate, and a bounded consequence without retaining the full narrative or metadata context.
connections.pattern_description: OBSERVATION -> GATE/CONSTRAINT -> BOUNDED_CONSEQUENCE remains recoverable after removal of presentation-specific context.
alternative_explanations: The same JSON authoring style may induce the apparent three-stage structure.
The selected records may already have been designed around bounded claims.
connections.falsification_route: Apply independent encoders to raw source material and test whether the same minimal three-stage core is recovered without JANUS schema labels.

connections.machine_observation: Removing supporting narrative does not automatically remove the distinction between an observation and the stronger claim it cannot justify.
connections.pattern_description: The admissible claim remains bounded even after the data representation is compressed.
alternative_explanations: The apparent ceiling may be encoded by repeated normative language rather than by the underlying data structure.
Some records may not contain enough raw evidence to test the ceiling independently.
connections.falsification_route: Blindly remove all interpretive wording and ask independent evaluators to reconstruct the strongest admissible claim from the remaining source fields.

connections.machine_observation: Distinct domains repeatedly contain a transition of the form INPUT/STATE -> GATE/TRANSFORMATION -> LIMITED OUTPUT/ACTION.
connections.pattern_description: The recurring object is the transition topology, not the domain-specific content.
alternative_explanations: This may be a universal schema induced by how JANUS stores any research decision.
The same operator can be a generic decision-process pattern rather than a novel cross-domain structure.
connections.falsification_route: Search a matched null set of unrelated JSON records with the same schema and estimate the baseline frequency of the same transition topology.

connections.machine_observation: Integrity and audit artifacts repeatedly wrap existing claims rather than adding new source-level observations.
connections.pattern_description: Verification of representation is orthogonal to multiplication of source information.
alternative_explanations: A validator can sometimes generate genuinely new information if it independently measures or observes the underlying process.
Some proof records may contain both validation and novel measurement.
connections.falsification_route: Classify each field as source observation, transformation, validation, or metadata and count only new source-level information in the independent-information graph.

connections.machine_observation: A bounded transition pattern appears across biological, computational, temporal, narrative and experimental JSON records.
connections.pattern_description: The candidate invariant is not a shared entity or mechanism; it is a repeated control topology: observe/state -> constrain/transform -> bounded result.
alternative_explanations: The registry may be dominated by records created specifically to formalize gates, making operator recurrence expected.
The pattern may be too general to be informative without a matched null benchmark.
connections.falsification_route: Generate or select a schema-matched null corpus, remove all domain and title information, and compare operator recurrence against the real data.

next_scan_strategy.name: MINIMAL_CORE_NULL_BENCHMARK
next_scan_strategy.target: Test whether the minimal information cores and abstract operators found in data remain informative after removal of registry-specific language and against matched nulls.
next_scan_strategy.promotion_rule: A candidate remains DISCOVERED until minimal-core survival and null comparison are available; promotion beyond discovery requires source-level independence and, where applicable, external replication.

canonical_rule: Do not ask only whether two records are connected. Ask which smallest information elements make the connection visible, whether those elements survive independent representation, and whether the same structure is rare under a matched null.
